title: scenarios/pads/{id}/summary.json
description: D21 parking option (picker pad) summary (C file layout 2026-11-14 16:17): the pad, its D21 rank and score (feasible-EVA count), tiebreak values, the headline at the 30- and 60-min walkback budgets (reachable % of the assessed flat disc, range [conservative, optimistic]) and the route summary, all for the nominal scenario of scenarios/pads/index.json. The 60-min reachable % may be null (60-min disc leaves the grid); a range end may be null. id equals the folder name, and each headline key equals its budget_min when given (checked by tools/validate_contracts.py). Producer WS2 (pipeline/engine/padpick.py); manifest keys pads.{id}.*. Added in v1.1.4; extra keys allowed. v1.1.5: optional feasible block (D45).

id.description: pad id = folder name under scenarios/pads/

scenario.description: scenario of every number here and of the pad's route/timeline files, e.g. nom_104

headline.description: per walkback budget (key = budget in min as text, "30", "60")

budget_min.description: the budget, min (WS2 writes it; when present it must equal the key)

reachable_pct.description: reachable % of the assessed flat disc at this budget (nominal); null = not computed (e.g. the 60-min disc leaves the grid)

range_pct.description: [conservative, optimistic] reachable %, from the pad's con/opt return fields

route.description: route summary of the pad's best feasible EVA; null = no route

files.description: data paths of the pad's files (bands, edges, partner, route, timeline)

feasible.description: v1.1.5, optional (D45 of set A): how many station combinations the planning rule keeps. screen_count = screening count (walk + dwell within the EVA budget, no margin check); full_run_count = exact DP count with margin >= 0 on every leg (the D21 score); excluded_by_effort_cap_rule = screen_count - full_run_count. Extra keys allowed.
